descriptionHtml:
Approach · TC-07 Task Export · S13 No bleed between contexts: Hospital view never shows a Nursing Home task, even by direct URL

UAT steps / ticket ACs covered:

  • U1 One consolidated in-app end-of-day view lists every open task across all of the physician's patients, each attributed to its patient (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 2) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U10 All of the above works in both Hospital and Nursing Home (UAT TC-07; UAT 3.3; TFA-92585 AC 12) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr
  • U9 'Email Tasks' is absent from the task screen: the button and the functionality, not just unused (UAT TC-07; TFA-92585 AC 11) — gate: blocked: TFA-92585 ready for pr

Test design technique: Error guessing (error-guessing) — Go straight for the places most likely to break (failures, double clicks, two tabs, a wrong clock, injected instructions).

Given Standard fixture; one open task added on each chart

When Hospital selected: open Hospital Task Export, then type /snf/tasks directly; switch to Nursing Home: open its Task Export, then type /rounding/tasks directly

Then Each screen shows only its own context's patient and task; a direct URL never renders the other context's task inside the current screen and is never blank

Pass rule (oracle, excerpt): TC-21 'no data leakage' applied to the task screens. mustContain/mustNotContain per checkpoint; cp1 and cp3 also carry the runnable no-Email / no-mailto check for both contexts (S02 / S06 are blocked). cp2 and cp4 can only judge that nothing leaks: 'renders, not blank, no error' is in spec.manual for a person (oracleRules 7), and what the screen should be is Q2. …

Where it ran: dev; test method AGENT · Browser agent; lane planned in the matrix: browser agent (automated)

S13 is our own case number (its number in the coverage matrix cases/TC-07.matrix.json), not a step number of the UAT document.

Environment: dev — dev deployment, build e02167f (Deploy Convex, 2026-10-12T18:24:27Z); account and address are not written into the report; run folder runs/2026-10-14-dev.

Test method: AGENT · Browser agent; secondary: VISUAL · Visual (screenshots for a person) — as classified in cases/test-methods.json, which says it runs on both; Source: dev.
